description: Exact CDR product-reference detail for one institution and product: every published lending or deposit rate entry and tier, with fees, features, eligibility, constraints, source quality flags, the date the version was recorded and the lender's own links. asOf returns the version current on that date. Detail exists for CDR products from 2026-06-12; it holds the conditions a headline rate leaves out.

asOf.description: Latest snapshot on or before YYYY-MM-DD. Optional.

name: rate_details
